title: Design is Addition
summary: An event identity for AGDA: two brackets meet to form a plus, because design adds our ideas together.

hero.alt: An Instagram post by agdagram on bright blue: “Design is + Addition, on now, 1–10 November, presented by AGDA.”

sections.heading: The Brief
body: Design is Addition is a coursework project with AGDA (the Australian Graphic Design Association) as the client. The prompt was to complete the phrase “Design is…” and build an identity around it. I chose “addition”: design brings people together and adds our thoughts to the world.

sections.heading: The Logo
body: The logo is two brackets coming together, and the white space between them forms a plus sign. The brackets stand for our individual minds and the ideas held inside them. When they meet, the ideas combine and are brought to life, digitally or by hand.
The plus is the most direct symbol of addition, and it is also two rectangles merging into one.

media.alt: The Design is Addition logo: two black square brackets facing each other, with “Design is Addi+ion” beside them, the t replaced by a plus.
media.caption: Two brackets, one plus.

sections.heading: Typography
body: The typeface is Gabarito, a geometric sans-serif designed by Álvaro Franca, Leandro Assis and Felipe Casaprima. Its clean, simple shapes suit AGDA’s professional voice, and it fits the theme too: it has been reworked by different designers over time, each adding ideas of their own.

media.alt: Typography spread: a blue panel about Gabarito, a large pangram, and the Regular and Black character sets.
media.caption: Gabarito Regular and Black.

sections.heading: Applications
body: The identity runs from social media to the exhibition space and a printed publication, using bold AGDA blue, the plus and the brackets throughout.

media.alt: Exhibition wall in AGDA blue reading “Design is Addi+ion, 1–10 November 2023”, with a large white plus holding a block of text and a person standing in front.
media.caption: Exhibition wall.

media.alt: An open magazine with a feature on Gordon Andrews and blue bracket graphics, next to its cover showing a large plus between “Design is” and “Addition”.
media.caption: Printed publication.
